name: A scorched smell in the service bay
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) with the mains taken (FS47FreeformSession::SkyCutBegin): the standby generator rides it, and the mains come back (150 s after the sag, 20 s): the tube beat and its thought wait for the mains to return. Every sabotage costs the control room the next two working ceiling tubes of 2 to 7 for good (tube beat with next, saved; the working light, tubes 0 and 1, stays). A pair of tubes from the store puts them back (FS47FreeformWorld depot).

beats.text: The whole place smells like a struck match.

At {clock} the mains sagged and went with no storm and no fault on the feeder. Afterward the transfer panel smelled scorched, like a struck match. Two of the ceiling tubes in the control room never struck again.
Two more of the tubes in here never came back. The Caliche shop counter sells them in pairs.
